messages.subject: Project Indigo - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Isobel, Marcus,

Attached are the agreed heads of terms (subject to contract) reflecting the £14,750,000 headline, 10% deposit on exchange and an 8-week exclusivity from 14 October. Completion target is 20 working days after exchange. Note the Unit 3 rent review and Unit 5 tenant break are flagged - we'll want these reflected in the price.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
